name: Natural Capsules Ltd
title: Natural Capsules Ltd - 524654 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin 2.28% on deferred dispatches; FY26 EBITDA loss Rs 1.56 cr; FY27 guidance Rs 274 cr revenue with API at ~Rs 70 cr and no PLI assumed, but debt stays Rs 100-110 cr.

utilisation.quote: Land utilization at this point of time is roughly around 25% to 30%.

capex.peers_comment: Chinese steroidal API overcapacity; Chinese players dumping into India at prices that may not cover costs.
capex.quote: Ican think about Rs. 25 crores to Rs. 30 crores of expenses could be required to put up these two clean rooms.

triggers.label: Indian steroidal API prices below cost
triggers.quote: Indian prices are very, very significantly lower, | would say and may not even cover their costs.

triggers.label: API land utilisation 25-30%
triggers.quote: Land utilization at this point of time is roughly around 25% to 30%.

triggers.label: US HPMC sales stopped after July
Prior API breakeven timeline missed
triggers.quote: there have been multiple instances starting FY24 till FY26, where timelines on earnings calls were not met.

triggers.label: Fermentation ~40% capacity spare, Fermbox to use
triggers.quote: at least about 40% of our capacity becomes spare in fermentation.

guidance.value: Rs 274 crore (gelatin 170, HPMC 20, domestic API 70, Fermbox CMO 14)
guidance.quote: we are talking about a consolidated level Rs.274 crores.
We are now anticipating revenue of about 20 crores from HPMC line.
I see around Es. 100 crores to Rs. 110 crores total debt on the consolidated basis.

guidance.value: 2-3% gross; EBITDA negligible to low single digit
guidance.quote: There we are expecting a margin of about 2-3% at the gross level.

prior_guidance_check.metric: API cash breakeven by end Q4 FY26
prior_guidance_check.quote: commercial sales only commenced in Q4 FY26.
we could not achieve the targeted revenue of 25 crores and we achieved only around Rs. 8 crores.

prior_guidance_check.metric: API revenue Rs 240-250 crore target by FY29
prior_guidance_check.quote: Yes, Rs. 250 crore target is still there in front of us.

red_flags.label: Near-zero cash, loss-making consolidated P&L, fundraising under consideration
red_flags.quote: there are close to five concurrent strategic priorities for a company at a near zero cash balance and a loss making consolidated P&L.

red_flags.label: Repeated missed timelines FY24-FY26
red_flags.quote: there have been multiple instances starting FY24 till FY26, where timelines on earnings calls were not met.

red_flags.label: HPMC FY26 shortfall, US sales halted
red_flags.quote: that was mainly due to stoppage of exports to US.

evasions.topic: Expected HPMC revenue in base case and delay sensitivity
evasions.quote: So, looking into the uncertainty of the US market where the business of Neutra segment has completely slowed down.

evasions.topic: Fermbox revenue scale-up and PLI timing
evasions.quote: since there is uncertainty of timing and all that we have desisted from giving a forecast.
the claw-back clause is referring to FY29 figures and that also is already mentioned in our shareholders agreement
